notes.title: Energized! Airdashing, rocket boosting, and charge bombs!
notes.content:
[b]New Techniques[/b]
[list]
[*] added charge bomb, by holding trigger and releasing upon charge
[*] added rocket boosting, by holding grasp and holding jump
[*] added air dashing, by jumping then holding grasp and pressing trigger
[*] added enemy pulling/grabbing, by holding grasp and holding trigger
[*] zero gravity climbing twist now allows total rotation control
[/list]
[b]Energy[/b]
[list]
[*] charge bomb uses 1/4 energy meter
[*] rocket boosting uses fuel meter and some energy
[*] air dashing uses 1/4 fuel meter and some energy
[*] added low HP red flashing at 1HP
[*] added low HP healing if energy recovers past 3/4 meter
[*] added built-in shock absorber for impacts using 1/2 meter if available
[*] energy now recovers over time
[*] energy now recovers when moving quickly
[*] added black/white gravity shift indicator to background of energy meter
[/list]
[b]Levels[/b]
[list]
[*] split gravity grotto into water bubble level and exploration/shop level
[*] split frozen laboratory into falling level and exploration/shop level
[*] split cursed tomb into minecart pit explosive puzzle level, exploration/shop level, boss level
[*] split event horizon into vertical gravity sled level, zero gravity block level, falling tower level
[/list]
[b]Upgrades[/b]
[list]
[*] added upgrade manager to in-game menu to toggle unlocked upgrades at will
[*] added gem magnet upgrade, pulling them close for easy collection
[*] added gem charger upgrade, more energy from gems
[*] added implosion catalyst upgrade, faster bomb charging with bigger blast radius
[*] added dream catcher upgrade, faster energy recovery when moving quickly
[*] added rocket reservoir upgrade, more rocket fuel and less energy usage
[*] added shifting gyroscope, repeated gravity shifts without landing
[*] added enemy yank, longer range enemy pulling with stun
[*] added gravity claws, more powerful airdash and less energy usage
[/list]
[b]Enemies[/b]
[list]
[*] fixed scorpion leaving stun before reaching ground when thrown
[*] fixed snail following player gravity erroneously
[*] added green gravity frog, which leaps using the player's gravity
[*] added orange/blue coloring to inversion frog based on current gravity
[*] added more enemies to capsules
[*] decreased max spike damage to 2, preventing full HP instakills
[/list]
[b]Visuals/Effects[/b]
[list]
[*] treasure crate is now purple/gold
[*] explosive crate is now red/silver
[*] cursed tomb room coloring algorithm adjusted for uniqueness and feel
[*] curled up avatar legs when climbing or zero gravity is active
[*] added black stripes to avatar tail
[*] added blue tail rocket flames to avatar
[*] added purple rocket boot flames
[*] minimap changes side based on first-person/avatar
[/list]
[b]Options[/b]
[list]
[*] improved compatibility of VR hand/input swapping
[*] simplified controls menu with cycling filter based on current scheme
[*] added option to hide stats
[*] added option to hide energy meter
[*] added universal "back" input to menu, allowing easier menu traversal
[/list]

notes.title: 2023.06.26.1 - Seed of Revenge
notes.content:
No longer will dying return you to all the way to the beginning, forcing you to retread early biomes, unable to retry the challenge that bested you because the seed is lost. 

Get revenge with immediate respawns at the beginning of the level, or retry the entire run by learning the seed upon ejection.

[list]
[*] seed is now shown above stats on menu, with an initial ? if unseeded or ! if seeded
[*] unseeded runs now choose from a valid seed which is hidden during play and revealed upon ejection
[*] seed now only regenerates after ejection
[*] reduced penalty of death to automatically respawning at the beginning of the current level with full health
[*] added death reason subtitle while stunned and awaiting respawn
[*] added credits to Options menu
[*] enemies are now automatically dropped if they die while grabbed
[*] extended range of jackhammer and allowed double block destruction
[*] re-enabled collision impact damage, as gravity claws are sufficient to maintain control while falling
[*] simplified tutorial
[*] added keymap tip to beginning of tutorial
[/list]

[*] adjusted event horizon tower to include platforms in the climbing shaft

[*] added enemy grabbing: enemies touched by grasping claws will be grabbed in the tool hand and highlighted orange, can be thrown by pulling tool trigger
[*] improved teleporter visuals
[*] removed whip attack, replaced with laser blaster
[*] added delay to energized black hole shot
[*] fixed unintended micro rotations in XR by preventing accrual of interpolation offset unless using mouse

[*] snail now receives launching knockback upon hit
[*] increased enemy health and gems to improve balance with new laser blaster and enemy grabbing options
[/list]

notes.title: Enemy and Game Loop Overhaul
notes.content:
[b]Design[/b]
- filling up the energy ring with 10 orbs now gives 1 health back, instead of providing an upgrade point
- 1 upgrade is now always provided upon level end
- restricted gravity-shifting to once per air-time
- prevented climbing while moving upwards quickly
- extended left claw into climbing position while falling
- removed gold chunks from wall blocks for performance and game balance consistency
- removed prices from shop items to encourage using items without needing to grind money collection
- removed item targeting action and replaced with auto continuous pickup
- automatically swap to 3rd person camera when avatar is enabled
- increased whip hitbox radius by 50% 
- added -vrmode launch option to control whether XR is requested
- allowed timekeeper to continue controlling time while swapped to inventory
- added low-speed hitbox to spikes dealing 1 damage
- increased minimum death speed for spikes to require falling multiple blocks of distance
- added 0.1s hitlag locking enemies in place during a damaging hit
- prevented knockback stacking on enemies when in hitlag
- frog now explodes upon death
- frog now always dismounts the ceiling upon receiving damage
- allowed scorpion to quickly combo into another attack if the player doesn't reposition after getting hit

- added smoke trails when enemies are launched
- changed frog color to orange, added white belly
- added balled-up rolling stun animation to scorpion
- added dark accents to scorpion
- added light accents to hawk
- replaced matching-wall-color spikes with consistent white
[b]Fixes[/b]
- tuned gravity shift head camera compensation to match rotation
- fixed event horizon loop seam timing inconsistency
- improved smoothness of rotation while climbing
- improved double jump magnitude consistency
- enabled interpolation to energy orbs for smooth movement while using timekeeper
- decoupled joystick and mouse movement to work independently and without conflict
- tutorial tips now only swap between controller and keyboard tips when a mouse click or bumper press is detected
- improved consistency of mouse movement in menu on variable framerates
- fixed controller detection not occurring on Steam Deck
- adjusted controller tutorial tips to use Xbox terms
- fixed flickering of menu fade on first opening
- added trap triggering to grappling hook rope
- added 1.5s auto reset timer to hammer
- ensured stats are updated instantly when damaged or collecting money
